metadata.question: Was there more green vegetation visible around Onemen Bay near Anadyr on August 9, 2025, than on September 11, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) – it has 10 m pixels, red & NIR bands for NDVI, and is available for 2025. - Geometry: a ~5 km buffer around Onemen Bay (64.5 N, 177.6 E) to capture coastal tundra/grass. - Date filters: exactly 9 Aug 2025 and 11 Sep 2025 (single day each). 2. Masking strategy: - Apply the scene’s QA60 cloud mask (bits 10 & 11). - After masking, count valid NDVI pixels; if 0 → C2. 3. Logic: - Compute mean NDVI for each date. - If either result is None/NaN → C3. - Compare means: if Aug > Sep → A (Yes), else B (No). - If either collection size == 0 → C1. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time bay = ee.Geometry.Point(177.6, 64.5).buffer(5000) aug9 = ee.Date('2025-08-09') sep11 = ee.Date('2025-09-11') def ndvi_mean(day): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(bay) .filterDate(day, day.advance(1, 'day')) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask( img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(0x1800).eq(0)) .normalizedDifference(['B8','B4']) .rename('ndvi'))) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 img = col.mean() cnt = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), bay, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndvi').getInfo() if cnt == 0: return None, 0 mean = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), bay, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndvi').getInfo() return mean, cnt ndvi_aug, pix_aug = ndvi_mean(aug9) ndvi_sep, pix_sep = ndvi_mean(sep11) print(f"Aug9 NDVI: {ndvi_aug} (pixels: {pix_aug})") print(f"Sep11 NDVI: {ndvi_sep} (pixels: {pix_sep})") if ndvi_aug is None or ndvi_sep is None: print("C2") elif ndvi_aug > ndvi_sep: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
bay = ee.Geometry.Point(177.6, 64.5).buffer(5000)
aug9 = ee.Date('2025-08-09')
sep11 = ee.Date('2025-09-11')

def ndvi_mean(day):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
             .filterBounds(bay)
             .filterDate(day, day.advance(1, 'day'))
             .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(
                     img.select('QA60').bitwiseAnd(0x1800).eq(0))
                  .normalizedDifference(['B8','B4'])
                  .rename('ndvi')))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    img = col.mean()
    cnt = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), bay, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndvi').getInfo()
    if cnt == 0:
        return None, 0
    mean = img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), bay, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndvi').getInfo()
    return mean, cnt

ndvi_aug, pix_aug = ndvi_mean(aug9)
ndvi_sep, pix_sep = ndvi_mean(sep11)

print(f"Aug9 NDVI: {ndvi_aug} (pixels: {pix_aug})")
print(f"Sep11 NDVI: {ndvi_sep} (pixels: {pix_sep})")

if ndvi_aug is None or ndvi_sep is None:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif ndvi_aug > ndvi_sep:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
